# Vertical 9:16 reframe of the talking-head edit

The 16:9 talking-head edit reframed to a 1080x1920 vertical for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. The centre crop keeps the presenter; long caption lines and the wide edit timeline are cut, which is why a real vertical cut re-flows its captions.

- Type: Vertical reframe
- Skill: `magnifito-variants`
- Engine: `reframe`
- Output: 1080x1920, 8 s, with audio
- Video: [`../videos/f01-reframe-vertical.mp4`](../videos/f01-reframe-vertical.mp4)
- Footage: synthetic, generated by the commands below. No camera footage is used.

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Use the magnifito-variants skill to turn the Magnifito talking-head edit (showcase/videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4) into a vertical 9:16 clip for Reels and Shorts. Take 8 seconds from 2.7 s, centre-crop so the presenter and her captions stay in frame, and save it as work/vertical.mp4.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- f01-reframe-vertical
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/f01-reframe-vertical/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
ffmpeg -ss 2.7 -t 8 -i ../videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/source.mp4
mgvideo reframe work/source.mp4 --ratio 9:16 --strategy crop --out work/vertical.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/vertical.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
